quests.title: Anomaly: Snezhnaya

dialogue.section: Check out the situation to the east of Snezhnograd

dialogue.t: Alyosha, what's going on here? Do you have any idea?
This nail cast down by the Heavenly Principles is glowing. From time to time, it also makes a sound...
I may have been one of the first witnesses, since I happened to be out hunting nearby.
So far, at least, it doesn't seem harmful. I notified the local Druzhna as soon as I came across it, so the Tsaritsa and the Fatui should be aware of it by now.
Do you think... this is Ronova's doing? Some way of getting her revenge?
We'll have to wait and see. All we know is, we defeated Celestia's Ruler of Death, and then the Heavenly Principles' nail started acting strange... However you look at it, it can't be good.
Hopefully, the military's keenest minds will be able to get to the bottom of it. Until then, we should keep a close eye on this area for any other changes.

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
